headline: 18 equity mutual funds deliver double-digit returns from Diwali 2025 to Diwali 2026
hook: Eighteen equity funds deliver double-digit annual gains
summary: Around 18 equity mutual funds delivered double-digit returns between Diwali 2025 and Diwali 2026. Motilal Oswal Focused Fund topped performers with 21.59% gains, followed by various smallcap and diversified funds. This performance highlights the returns generated by active equity fund management over the past year. Retail mutual fund investors tracking category averages can use these figures to benchmark their personal portfolios.
why_it_matters: Compare your equity fund returns against these benchmark performers.
winners_losers: Active fund investors gain / laggard funds trail

headline: Select equity mutual funds show strong SIP gains since last Diwali
hook: Eight equity funds deliver double-digit SIP returns
summary: Eight equity mutual funds have generated double-digit returns for SIP investors since Diwali last year. Samco Small Cap Fund led the pack with a 30.85% return, followed by Motilal Oswal Focused Fund and Bank of India Small Cap Fund. Despite these gains, 255 other equity funds reported negative returns during the same period. This highlights the impact of market volatility on individual fund performance.
why_it_matters: Portfolio performance varies significantly based on fund selection and market volatility.
winners_losers: Small cap investors gain / underperforming fund holders hurt
